Subject: Invoice 20261101 — payment held pending VAT evidence

Hi Stephanie,

We're showing Invoice RD-2026-0457 (dated 01 Nov) in our AP queue, but Treasury has placed the payment on hold. The VAT number you supplied at signup (GB999999973) appears to be associated with Redwood UK Ltd, while our contract references Redwood EU SARL (FR). Our finance team needs evidence of the EU VAT registration or a self-billing agreement before we can release payment under reverse-charge rules.

Can you confirm which legal entity should receive the payment, and share the EU VAT cert or signed self-billing authorization? If you think reverse-charge applies, please explain the logic so our tax team can sign off.

Regards,

Streamline AI

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Invoice 20261101 — payment held pending VAT evidence

Hi Priya — thanks for the flag and sorry for the friction. Short answer: we can accept payment to either Redwood UK Ltd or Redwood EU SARL depending on your preference, but tax treatment changes. A quick summary:

- If you pay Redwood EU SARL (FR VAT), the invoice is standard B2B EU sale and VAT should not be charged by you (we'd issue with FR VAT details).
- If you pay Redwood UK Ltd (GB VAT), and you're in the EU, reverse-charge may be appropriate — but your AP needs a valid EU VAT number for the recipient (ours is FRXXXXXXXXX) or the supplier must supply evidence.

I'm looping in Rishi (finance) and Grace (sales ops) to propose an operational path so we can get this out of suspense without a full tax review.

Proposed steps (can we agree today?):
1) Streamline picks the paying entity (UK vs FR).
2) If paying FR entity: we reissue invoice to Redwood EU SARL and provide FR VAT cert.
3) If paying UK entity: provide your self-billing or accept reverse-charge; we will provide VAT evidence and re-code with the correct tax treatment.
4) Redwood will allow a short-term suspense release: partial settlement into a suspense account until documentation is confirmed (typical for enterprise).

I can circulate the required docs (FR VAT cert + signed self-billing) by Friday. Let me know which entity you prefer.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: Invoice_RD-2026-0457-20261101.pdf (pdf)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Invoice 20261101 — payment held pending VAT evidence

Hi all — Rishi from Finance. We can do a pragmatic approach to avoid a long delay. A few clarifications from our side:

- Our accounting system can split the net amount across entities if required (common when a company engages multiple legal entities). However, Streamline's AP needs clear GL mapping and an acceptance email to tie to the payment.
- For release from suspense: we require (A) a copy of the paying entity's VAT registration (if treating as reverse-charge), or (B) a signed self-billing authorization from Streamline if you want us to invoice under Redwood EU SARL and you prefer it that way.
- If payment is routed to a suspense account, we can accept a 50% provisional release to cover month-end cashflow, with the remainder released after receipt of documents. That is workable but needs a written agreement on timing.

Action items I propose:
1) Priya confirms paying entity (UK vs FR) and whether Streamline will accept self-billing.
2) If FR: Stephanie to attach FR VAT cert and we will reissue invoice to Redwood EU SARAL within 24h.
3) If UK: Priya to confirm that Streamline will apply reverse-charge and send us the accounting memo (or we accept your confirmation email for AP).

We can also accept the signed self-billing doc by e-signature (DocuSign OK).

Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
